about_the_game:
Overview

You are the Commander, prematurely thawed from cryo-sleep and dumped into the bridge of humanity's last starship. With most of Earth's finest minds still frozen, a half-broken AI (A.R.K.) at your side, and resources dwindling by the minute, you must guide your desperate crew through a hostile galaxy in search of a new home.

Juggle scarce supplies, respond to unpredictable events, and make gut-wrenching decisions as you chart a course through star systems teeming with danger, mystery, and darkly comedic disaster. Assign roles, repair systems, launch risky ground ops, and decide who's worth saving... or sacrificing.

Every button press could be the difference between survival and extinction. Humanity's last hope is in your hands... and your hands are probably shaking.

Game Features

  • Command the Last Hope
    Take charge as the Commander of Earth's final sleeper ship, managing all major decisions from your starship interface, with the dubious help of your darkly humorous AI, A.R.K.

  • Procedural Exploration & Scanning
    Jump between star systems, scan planets for vital resources, and chart a course through unknown dangers in search of a new home for humanity.

  • Deep Crew Management
    Every crew member is unique, with specialized skillsets, unpredictable personalities, and a full roster of afflictions like physical, mental, and just plain weird. Assign doctors, engineers, soldiers, and scientists to critical duties; the wrong fit can mean disaster.

  • Cryo Chamber Dilemmas
    Wake more crew for greater capability, but drain precious resources and risk new problems, tension, and mutiny.

  • Hostile Space Combat
    Fend off enemy ships and cosmic marauders in tense, tactical battles to protect your ship and crew.

  • Dynamic Afflictions & Morale
    Crew can suffer injuries, illnesses, psychological breaks, and mysterious cosmic ailments. Personality clashes, drama, and dropping morale can lead to full-on mutiny.

  • Ground & Boarding Operations

    Deploy your crew on risky away missions, explore planets, abandoned ships, and derelict stations to scavenge resources, uncover secrets, or fight for survival.

  • Strategic Resource & Ship Management
    Juggle critical supplies like fuel, medicine, food, parts, and keep the ARK patched up. Ship system repairs, efficient crew assignments, and creative repurposing are all that stand between survival and oblivion.

  • Random Events & Encounters
    Respond to distress calls, encrypted messages, and unpredictable galactic phenomena, sometimes with words, sometimes with missiles.

  • Dark Humor & Black Comedy
    Face the apocalypse with a heavy dose of sarcasm, banter, and existential dread.

Future Features

  • Customize Your Commander
    Shape the personality and leadership style of your Commander. Choose to lead with compassion, ruthless efficiency, biting sarcasm, or something in between. Your choices shape dialogue and the fate of your crew.

  • Repurpose Your A.R.K.
    Convert and adapt ship sections to fit your evolving needs: turn storage bays into medbays, retrofit cryo-chambers, or jury-rig new defenses to survive whatever space throws at you.

  • Branching Choices & Consequences
    Every decision of who to wake, how to respond, what to repair, shapes your story and your crew's fate.

  • Multiple Endings
    Your actions truly matter, unlock a variety of endings based on your decisions, sacrifices, and just how much of humanity you managed to save (or doom).

content_descriptors.notes: Non-graphic and seldom description of violent acts, smoking, and drinking.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (NVIDIA/AMD, even older models)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 2.0 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any

short_description: Congratulations, Commander! You've been prematurely awakened from cryosleep to fix everything. Hope you like impossible odds, and pressing glowing buttons to decide who lives, dies, or gets spaced. Keep the ship running, the crew alive-ish, and the existential dread manageable.
